about.body: ZOOD PDF is an open, account-free, Arabic-first editor for PDF files. Everything runs locally in your browser: no file is uploaded, and a document's text leaves your device only when you send it to an AI model yourself.

ai.noText: These pages have no text ZOOD PDF can read — they may be scanned images — so there is nothing to send.

ai.nothingFits: Page {page} alone holds more text than one request can carry ({budget} characters).

ai.pii.locating: Finding each one on its page…
ai.pii.marked: Places marked for redaction: {count}. Apply them in Redact.
ai.pii.notMarked: Nothing was marked: marks are placed in the reading view, not in Edit text.

ai.tables.none: No tables were found on these pages.
ai.tables.note: One sheet per table, right to left when the table is Arabic, numbers as numbers written the way they were, merged cells kept.

app.name: ZOOD PDF
combine.failed: The files could not be combined.
combine.intro: Choose two or more PDFs. Their pages become one new file, in the order listed.

create.failed: The PDF could not be made from these files.
create.fidelity: ZOOD PDF lays out the content itself, in its own fonts: text and its direction, headings, lists, tables, pictures, headers and footers, and slides’ boxes come across. Complex layouts do not: columns, Word’s text boxes and shapes, charts, SmartArt, animations.
create.intro: Make a PDF from Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, web pages, Markdown, text, CSV and pictures, here on this device. Several files become one PDF, in the order listed.
create.list: Files to make into a PDF
create.missingGlyphs: Characters with no shape in ZOOD PDF’s fonts, shown as empty boxes: {count}.
create.ocr: Then read the text in the pictures (Scan & OCR)
create.ocrProgress: Reading the text of page {page} of {of}…
create.picturesLeftOut: Pictures left out — on the internet, in a format ZOOD PDF cannot draw, or damaged: {count}.
create.truncated: A file was too large to take whole; its far rows or last slides were left out.
compare.current: Revision {n} is the file as it stands now.
compare.failed: The two versions could not be compared.
compare.findFailed: The revisions of this file could not be read.
compare.intro: Shows what changed between two versions of a document, page by page: in the text, word by word, and in how each page looks.
compare.lookAlt: Page {page}, with what looks different outlined
compare.looksFailed: How the pages look could not be compared.
compare.looksHint: The words are the same, but some pages look different (pages: {count}): see Appearance.
compare.noText: Neither version has any text to compare. Scanned pages need a text layer first.
compare.note: The text is compared word by word; how each page looks is compared as it is drawn, which also shows pictures, drawings, stamps and layout.
compare.oneRevision: This file has only one revision: nothing has been saved onto it since it was made. Choose another PDF to compare it with.
compare.onlyNewer: This page is only in the newer version.
compare.onlyOlder: This page is only in the older version.
compare.optionsNote: These are the rules search follows in ZOOD PDF.
compare.pageCountsDiffer: Pages in the older version: {older}; in the newer: {newer}. Pages are compared by position, so a page added or removed early on makes the pages after it look changed.
compare.reportLetters: أ إ آ ٱ were counted as alef, taa marbuta (ة) as haa, and alef maqsura (ى) as yaa.
compare.unifyLetters: Count أ إ آ ٱ as alef, taa marbuta (ة) as haa, and alef maqsura (ى) as yaa
compare.unreadable: The file could not be read as a PDF.
compress.balancedNote: Images larger than a page needs at 150 dpi become JPEG. Good for sharing and printing.
compress.failed: The file could not be compressed.
compress.losslessNote: Every image stays as it is; the file is rebuilt tighter.
compress.note: The open file is not changed. The smaller copy is a new file; it keeps no earlier revisions.
compress.refusedProtected: This file has a password. A smaller copy is written from scratch and would lose it; remove the password with Protect first if you want one.
compress.refusedSigned: This file is signed. A smaller copy is written from scratch and would break the signature.
compress.smallestNote: For reading on a screen; images lose detail when printed.
compress.unchanged: This file is already as small as it gets at this level. Nothing was changed.
drop.combine: Drop PDFs to add them to the list
drop.combineHint: The dropped PDFs join it in Combine, where you choose the order
drop.create: Drop files to add them to the list
drop.openHint: Shows the dropped file in place of this one
drop.overlay: Drop a PDF to open it — several PDFs go to Combine together
edit.addNoUndo: Added text cannot be undone yet. Close without saving to discard it.
edit.failed: The paragraph could not be replaced.
edit.fontSubstituted: The original font of that paragraph could not be reused, so the face chosen in the Edit panel was embedded instead. The replaced text may look different from the rest of the page.
edit.autoLookupInstalled: {wanted}: looked for among this computer's fonts when the edit is applied; otherwise {name}
edit.autoLookupLibrary: {wanted}: looked for in the open font library when the edit is applied; otherwise {name}
edit.autoLookupBoth: {wanted}: looked for among this computer's fonts, then in the open font library, when the edit is applied; otherwise {name}
edit.fontUsed.installed: The new text needs letters the file's own copy of {name} does not have, so {name} was taken from this computer's fonts and embedded.
edit.fontUsed.downloaded: The new text needs letters the file's own copy of {name} does not have, so {name} was downloaded from the open font library and embedded. It is kept on this device for next time.
fontLibrary.askBody: This paragraph is set in {name}, and the new text needs letters the file does not carry. The same font can be downloaded from the open font library and kept on this device, so that edited text matches the rest of the page. Download matching fonts automatically?
fontLibrary.askSent: Only the font's name is sent, to api.fontsource.org and cdn.jsdelivr.net. The document, its text and everything else stay on this device.
fontLibrary.switch: Download matching fonts automatically when editing text
fontLibrary.title: Fonts
edit.autoBundledSame: {name}, which the app carries in full
edit.fontUsed.bundledSame: The new text needs letters the file's own copy of {name} does not have, so the app's copy of {name} was embedded. Its weight may differ from the rest of the page.
edit.autoIdle: Each paragraph keeps its own font where it can.
edit.fontShrunk: The new text was made smaller to fit the paragraph's box.
edit.fontUsed.bundled: This paragraph is set in {wanted}, which the file carries only in part, and the new text needs letters it does not have. The closest face the app carries, {name}, was embedded instead; the replaced text may look different from the rest of the page.
edit.fontUsed.bundledUnknown: The paragraph's own font could not draw the new text, so the closest face the app carries, {name}, was embedded instead. The replaced text may look different from the rest of the page.
edit.fontUsed.chosen: The face chosen in the Edit panel, {name}, was embedded in place of the paragraph's own font. The replaced text may look different from the rest of the page.
edit.hintAdd: Add text draws one line where you click; Arabic grows leftwards from that point.
edit.hintClick: Click a paragraph, or reach it with Tab and press Enter.
edit.hintFont: Automatic redraws a paragraph in the document's own font when the new text uses only letters the document already has (Latin text; Arabic is always reshaped). Otherwise the closest face is embedded, and you are told which. Choosing a face here overrides that.
edit.hintKeys: {mod}+Enter, or a click outside, applies the change; Esc discards it.
edit.intro: Replace a paragraph in place. The core reflows and reshapes the text, then the page is drawn again from the result.
edit.placeHere: Click where the text should start
editPdf.addLinkHere: Add a link on this page
editPdf.dropPicture: Drop a picture to place it on the page
editPdf.failed: That change could not be made to the page.
editPdf.hintCrop: With Crop on, the handles cut that side of the picture away.
editPdf.hintDrawLink: Drag on the page to draw a new link's area.
editPdf.hintKeys: Arrow keys nudge the picked picture (Shift for ten points); Delete removes it.
editPdf.hintLinkKeys: Arrow keys move the picked link (Shift for ten points); with Alt they resize it; Delete removes it.
editPdf.hintMove: Drag the picked picture to move it.
editPdf.hintMoveLink: Drag the picked link to move it, or a handle to resize it.
editPdf.hintResize: Drag a handle to resize it; hold Shift to keep its proportions.
editPdf.imageSharedNote: The same drawing puts this picture in several places, so it cannot be changed in one of them alone.
editPdf.inFormNote: This picture is drawn inside a group of the page's content: the change is made there, and it cannot be moved out of that group's area, where it would not show.
editPdf.linkOther: This link goes somewhere ZOOD PDF does not follow (another file or a script). Give it an address or a page to change that.
editPdf.notPicture: Only PNG and JPEG pictures can be placed.
editPdf.pickLink: Click a link on the page to change it.
editPdf.pickPicture: Click a picture on the page to pick it.
editPdf.placing: Drag on the page where {name} goes, or click to place it at its own size. Shift fills the box exactly.
error.notPdf: Only PDF files can be opened.
error.password: This file is protected with a password.
export.excelNote: Each table on the pages — drawn with lines or lined up in columns — cell for cell, with merged cells kept and numbers as numbers (Arabic-Indic digits too); the rest of each page’s text in rows. A right-to-left page makes a right-to-left sheet. Charts and pictures are not kept.
export.failed: The document could not be exported.
export.htmlNote: Paragraphs, each with its own direction, and a heading for each page. No scripts, and nothing loaded from anywhere. Loses the layout and images.
export.imagesNote: Every page as a picture, exactly as it looks, at the resolution below. The text in a picture cannot be searched or selected. More than one page comes as one .zip.
export.intro: Save this document's content in another format. The text is each page as ZOOD PDF itself reads it, in reading order, taken from the file as it is now: text you have redacted is not in it.
export.markdownNote: Paragraphs as paragraphs, and a heading for each page. Loses the layout, fonts and images.
export.noText: No text was found in this document. If it is a scan, export page images instead; reading scans (OCR) comes later.
export.password: This copy is protected with a password set in Protect. Enter it to export.
export.pendingRedactions: Some marked areas have not been applied yet. A mark is not a redaction: until you apply it in Redact, the text under it is exported like the rest.
export.powerpointNote: A slide for each page, in the page’s shape: its pictures, shapes and colours behind, and its text on top in text boxes you can edit, where it was, right to left where it is Arabic. PowerPoint sets the text in its own fonts, so a line may run a little longer or shorter.
export.reduced: Some pages were too large for this resolution and were drawn at a lower one.
export.sheetsTable: One for each table (each page’s when there is none)
export.textNote: The text of every page in reading order, each page headed by a marker with its number. Loses the layout, fonts and images.
export.wordNote: Each page as it looks: its pictures, logos and colours behind the text, and the text in its own fonts, sizes and colours, in boxes you can edit. Choose “Text only, flowing” for flowing paragraphs instead.

forms.calc.applied: Saved in “{name}”. Other PDF readers that run form scripts calculate it too.
forms.calc.cycle: These calculations would depend on each other in a circle: {names}.
forms.calc.expressionNote: Use field names with + − × ÷ and parentheses. Put a name that has spaces in quotes.
forms.calc.noFields: This form has no text fields yet. Detect or add some first.
forms.calc.unsupported: This field has scripts ZOOD PDF does not run. Applying replaces its format, range and calculation.
forms.created: Fields created: {n}. Fill them in with Fill & sign, or give them formats and calculations below.
forms.detect.found: Fields found: {n}. Check them on the page before creating them.
forms.detect.none: No places to write were found. Add fields by hand below.
forms.detect.note: Finds where a flat form expects writing — lines of underscores or dots, empty boxes and table cells, lines to sign on, and check boxes — and names each field after its label.
forms.expr.syntax: ZOOD PDF cannot read this expression. Use field names, numbers, + − × ÷ and parentheses.
forms.failed: Prepare form could not finish. The file was not changed.
forms.format.hijriNote: Dates are typed as Hijri dates and checked against the Umm al-Qura calendar.
forms.proposal.name: Field name
forms.proposals.note: Drag a box to move it, drag its corner to resize it, and press Delete to remove it. Names come from the labels; change any you like.
forms.proposals.sameName: Two fields are named “{name}”. Fields with one name share one value, so give each its own.
forms.rejected.date: That is not a date in this field's pattern, so the previous value was kept.
forms.rejected.hijri: That is not a real Hijri date, so the previous value was kept.
forms.rejected.number: That value must be a number, so the previous one was kept.
forms.rejected.range: That value is outside the field's allowed range, so the previous one was kept.
forms.rejected.special: That value does not have the digits this field expects, so the previous one was kept.
forms.scripts.notRun: Scripts in this form that ZOOD PDF does not run: {n}
forms.scripts.why: ZOOD PDF runs only the standard formats, checks and calculations of form fields. Any other script is never executed; it is listed here so you know it is there.
forms.xfa.dropped: The XFA layer was removed. Every reader now shows the standard form.
forms.xfa.dynamic: This is a dynamic XFA form. Its pages are drawn by an XFA engine, which ZOOD PDF does not have: what you see is what the file shows without one, and it cannot be filled here.
forms.xfa.static: This is an XFA form. ZOOD PDF fills its standard form fields, but readers that use the XFA layer may still show the old values. Removing the XFA layer makes every reader show what you fill in.
goto.label: Page number (1–{total})
goto.title: Go to page
home.recentHint: Only the names and a small picture of each first page are kept, on this device; choose a file again to open it.
home.recentHintDesktop: Only the names, a small picture of each first page and where each file is are kept, on this device; choose a file to open it again.
home.title: Home
cloud.home.title: Cloud drives
cloud.home.noteWeb: A drive is reached only when you click. You sign in on Microsoft's own page: ZOOD PDF never sees your password.
cloud.home.noteDesktop: A drive is reached only when you click. You sign in on the provider's own page, in your browser: ZOOD PDF never sees your password, and keeps the sign-in in the system keychain until you sign out.
cloud.signOut.label: Sign out of {drive}
cloud.signOutNote.onedrive: Signing out forgets the sign-in on this device. Microsoft gives an app no way to withdraw its own access: to withdraw it, remove ZOOD PDF from your Microsoft account's app permissions.
cloud.signOutNote.gdrive: Signing out asks Google to withdraw ZOOD PDF's access, and forgets the sign-in on this device.
cloud.menu.saveToDevice: Save a Copy on This Device…
cloud.signIn.title: Sign in to {drive}
cloud.signIn.body.onedrive: Microsoft will ask you to allow ZOOD PDF to open and save your OneDrive files, to see your name, and to keep you signed in. You sign in on Microsoft's own page; ZOOD PDF never sees your password.
cloud.signIn.body.gdrive: Google shows its file picker as part of signing in: choose there the PDF to open. ZOOD PDF can see only the files you choose in it or save from ZOOD PDF, and nothing else in your Drive.
cloud.signIn.stay: Stay signed in on this browser
cloud.signIn.stayNote: Keeps the sign-in in this browser's storage for up to 24 hours, Microsoft's limit for web apps. Leave it off on a computer others use.
cloud.signIn.memory: Otherwise the sign-in lasts until you close this tab.
cloud.signIn.keychain: You stay signed in on this computer until you sign out; the sign-in is kept in the system keychain.
cloud.signIn.waitingPopup: Finish signing in in the window that opened.
cloud.signIn.waitingBrowser: Finish in your browser. ZOOD PDF comes back here when you are done.
cloud.pick.folder: Choose a Folder in Google Drive…
cloud.browse.empty: No folders or PDF files here.
cloud.browse.googleNote: ZOOD PDF sees only the files you chose in Google Drive's picker or saved from ZOOD PDF. To open another, choose it in Google Drive.
cloud.browse.googleEmpty: None yet: choose a file in Google Drive.
cloud.browse.name: Name
cloud.conflict.title: This file changed in {drive}
cloud.conflict.body: “{name}” was saved in {drive} after you opened it here — by someone else, or by another app. Saving now would replace that version.
cloud.conflict.history.onedrive: If you replace it, the other version stays in the file's version history in OneDrive.
cloud.conflict.history.gdrive: If you replace it, Google Drive keeps the other version in the file's history for 30 days.
cloud.taken.title: “{name}” already exists
cloud.taken.body: This folder in {drive} already has a file with that name.
cloud.signedOut.onedrive: Signed out of OneDrive on this device.
cloud.signedOut.gdrive: Signed out of Google Drive; Google withdrew the app's access.
cloud.signedOut.gdriveLocal: Signed out of Google Drive on this device; Google could not be reached to withdraw the app's access.
cloud.error.network: The drive could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
cloud.error.signedOut: The sign-in has ended. Sign in again to continue.
cloud.error.denied: The provider did not allow the sign-in.
cloud.error.timeout: The sign-in took too long and was stopped. Try again.
cloud.error.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this site, then try again.
cloud.error.state: A sign-in answer that was not for this request was ignored. Try again.
cloud.error.conflict: The file changed in the drive since you opened it.
cloud.error.nameTaken: A file with that name is already there.
cloud.error.notFound: The file or folder is no longer there.
cloud.error.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to open or change this file.
cloud.error.throttled: The drive is busy. Wait a moment, then try again.
cloud.error.server: The drive answered with an error. Try again.

link.confirmNote: Open it only if you trust this file: a link can lead somewhere other than its text suggests.
link.disguisedBody: This address holds invisible characters that can make it read as another address, so ZOOD PDF does not open it:
link.openFailed: The link could not be opened.
link.refusedBody: ZOOD PDF opens only web and e-mail addresses. This file links to something else:
marks.failed: The page marks could not be changed.
marks.intro: Watermarks, headers and footers, page numbers and Bates numbers, drawn into the file with Arabic shaped as it should be. They can be changed or taken off later without touching the page itself.
marks.listFailed: The marks already in this file could not be read; new ones can still be added.
marks.none: This file has no marks from ZOOD PDF yet.
marks.pagesHint: Empty for every page, or pages such as 1-3, 5.
marks.pagesInvalid: These are not pages of this file.
marks.preview: Page {page} with the mark, as it will be drawn
marks.previewFailed: The preview could not be drawn.
marks.replaceNote: A new mark replaces one of the same kind on the same pages.
marks.skipFirst: No number on the first page
marks.slotsHint: In an Arabic header the start is on the right; in an English one, on the left.
menu.label: Main menu
ocr.alreadyDone: These pages already have a text layer from ZOOD PDF.
ocr.done: Text layer added: {pages} pages, {words} words (confidence {confidence}%). Search and selection now work; save to keep it.
ocr.note: Recognition runs on this device; nothing is sent anywhere. Unless the cleaned-up picture is put in place of the scan, the page looks exactly as before: the text is invisible, over the words. Diacritics are rarely read reliably.
ocr.nothing: No page needed recognizing: every page already has text.
organize.cropTooMuch: Those margins would leave nothing of a page.
organize.cropWhich: Applies to the selected pages, or to every page when none is selected.
organize.extracted: The pages were saved as a new file.
organize.failed: The pages could not be changed.
organize.hint: Click a page to select it. Shift-click selects a run of pages; Cmd- or Ctrl-click adds one. Drag pages to move them.
organize.insertFailed: That file could not be read as a PDF.
organize.insertPassword: “{name}” is protected. Enter its password to insert its pages.
organize.insertWhere: Its pages go in after the last selected page, or at the end.
organize.keepOne: A document keeps at least one page.
organize.saveNote: Changes go into the file when you save it. Extracting writes a new file and leaves this one as it is.
organize.splitDone: The parts are saved in one zip file.
organize.splitOne: That makes only one file: choose fewer pages per file, or select where each part begins.
organize.splitSelected: A new file at each selected page

attachments.removed: Removed. The file's earlier version still holds it until the file is written whole: Remove hidden information, in Redact, takes it out for good.
attachments.added: Attached. Save the file to keep it.
attachments.tooLarge: A file larger than 256 MB cannot be attached.
attachments.failed: The attachments could not be read or changed.
batch.actionsNote: Actions are kept on this device only. Passwords are never saved with them.
batch.error.compressProtected: a protected file is not compressed, so it keeps its protection.
batch.error.compressSigned: a signed file is not compressed, so its signature stays valid.
batch.error.deleteAll: these are all of the file's pages.
batch.error.flattenProtected: a protected file is not flattened, so it keeps its protection.
batch.error.hiddenProtected: a protected file is not rewritten: take its password off first.
batch.error.needsPassword: The file is protected: give its password above.
batch.error.noPages: the file has none of these pages.
batch.error.noText: the file has no text to export (a scan? add Scan & OCR first).
batch.error.notPdf: This is not a PDF ZOOD PDF can open.
batch.error.notProtected: the file has no password to remove.
batch.error.pick: The files could not be read.

batch.error.write: The result could not be saved: {message}

ai.deviceSource: The model is not in the app. It is downloaded once, from Qwen’s own repository on Hugging Face, only when you press this button; the file is checked against the size and SHA-256 above before it is kept on this device.
ai.deviceReady: The model is on this device ({size}) and runs on {runtime}.
ai.deviceDelete: Delete the model from this device ({size})

ai.deviceDownloadFailed: The model could not be downloaded: {message}
ai.needDeviceModel: Download the on-device model first, or choose another provider.
ai.toThisDevice: Nowhere: the model runs inside the app on this device
ai.modelMissing: The on-device model is not downloaded yet.

ai.fill.profileSaved: Your saved details ({count} fields) are used first; add anything more below.
ai.fill.profileEmpty: No saved details yet: enter them once in Settings, or type them below.
profile.title: My details for forms

profile.forgotten: Your details were removed from this device.
profile.failed: Your details could not be saved on this device.

readAloud.label: Read aloud
readAloud.noText: There is no text to read here. A scanned page can be read after Scan & OCR.
readAloud.noSelection: Select the text to read first, then press The selection.
readAloud.noVoices: The system has no voice for this text, or reading stopped. Install a voice in the system’s settings and try again.
readAloud.unsupported: This browser cannot read aloud (no speech synthesis).
readAloud.moreVoices: The voices are the system’s own, offline. More — Arabic ones too — can be added in the system’s speech settings.
readAloud.moreVoicesApple: The voices are the system’s own, offline. More — including Enhanced and Premium ones, and Arabic voices such as Maged — can be downloaded in System Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content. Siri’s voices are not offered to apps.
readAloud.betterVoiceHint: This is the system’s basic voice. For a natural one, download a Premium or Enhanced voice — Majed for Arabic — in System Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › System Voice › Manage Voices. ZOOD PDF uses the best one installed by itself.
readAloud.naturalHint: Natural voices are read on this PC, offline, once downloaded — far smoother than Windows’ own. The Arabic voice is Kareem, from the open Piper project; ZOOD PDF puts the vowels in by itself before it reads.

ai.card.prompt.summarize: Summarize this document: one or two sentences on what it is, then its main points, each with its page.
ai.chat.whereDevice: Messages stay on this device: the model runs inside the app, and nothing is sent anywhere.
ai.chat.whereClaude: Messages, and the text of the document they need, go to {host} with your key.
ai.chat.whereLocal: Messages, and the text of the document they need, go to the local model at {url}, on this computer.
ai.chat.emptyText: Ask a question, or start with one of the suggestions below. Answers cite their pages, and are never written into the PDF.
ai.chat.analyzingFirst: This needs the whole document, so all of it is read first — once; what is learned is kept on this device.
ai.chat.progressOutline: Writing the outline of the document…
ai.chat.docLong: Pages: {total} — more than the model reads at once. Analyzing reads all of it once, in {parts} parts.
ai.chat.docAnalyzed: Analyzed: the assistant knows the whole document (pages: {total}).
ai.chat.docNoText: This file has no text to read — its pages may be scanned images.
ai.chat.noTextDocument: This document has no text ZOOD PDF can read — its pages may be scanned images — so there is nothing to answer from. Recognize its text with Scan & OCR first.
ai.chat.noTextPage: This page has no text to translate — it may be a scanned image. Recognize its text with Scan & OCR first.
ai.chat.stoppedPartial: Stopped here: the answer is incomplete.
ai.chat.tooLargeDevice: The request did not fit what the on-device model reads at once, even after it was shortened. Ask a shorter question, or start a new chat.
ai.chat.basisAnalysis: From the analysis of the whole document (pages: {total}).
ai.chat.basisPassages: From passages on pages {pages} of {total}; the rest was not read for this answer.
ai.chat.basisPassagesOutline: From passages on pages {pages} of {total}, and the outline of the whole document.
ai.chat.analysisDone: The document is analyzed, all of it (pages: {pages}; steps: {parts}). This is kept on this device, so it is not read again.
ai.chat.analysisKept: This document was already analyzed (pages: {pages}; steps: {parts}): what is kept on this device is used.
ai.chat.analysisStopped: The analysis was stopped. What was read is kept; it goes on from there next time.
ai.chat.analysisFailed: The document could not be analyzed.
ai.chat.reviewWhole: All of it (pages: {total}; characters: {characters}), with each message.
ai.chat.reviewParts: Pages: {total}; characters: {characters}. Too long for one request, so its text goes in parts — the passages a question needs, or all of it, part by part, for a summary.
ai.chat.reviewOnce: After you send, later messages about this document go to the same place without asking again — until the app is closed, or the provider, the model or the address changes.
ai.setup.title: Model settings
ai.setup.keptNote: A long document is analyzed once, and its summaries are kept on this device under a fingerprint of its text — not its name. They are never sent anywhere.
ai.tasks.title: Document tools
ai.tasks.intro: Each of these is one request whose answer you review before anything is done with it. They use the model chosen in the model settings; nothing is sent until you have seen what will go and where, and pressed Send.
quick.title: Quick PDF tools
quick.noFiles: No file came with this window: the files were moved, or are no longer there.
quick.noTools: These files cannot be worked on together. Choose only PDFs, or only pictures and documents.
quick.unavailable: The quick tools work in the desktop app, from the right-click menu.
quick.onePdf: Put them all in one PDF
quick.combineOrder: The files are combined in the order shown, into one file beside the first.
quick.password: Password (only if the files are locked)
quick.beside: Each result is saved beside its original with a new name. Nothing is overwritten.
quick.note.compress: Makes the file smaller; pictures lose a little detail.
quick.note.word: An editable Word document of the text and pictures.
quick.note.images: Each page as a picture (several pages come in a zip).
quick.note.ocr: Makes the text of scanned pages searchable and copyable.
quick.note.combine: Joins the files into one PDF.
quick.note.extract: A new PDF of only the pages you choose.
quick.note.protect: A password to open the file, and what others may do with it.
quick.note.topdf: A PDF of each picture, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text or web file.
quick.note.excel: The tables of each page as an Excel workbook.
quick.note.powerpoint: Each page as a PowerPoint slide.
quick.note.text: The text alone, as a plain text file.
quick.note.split: Several PDFs: one every so many pages, or one for each part you write.
quick.note.resize: Puts every page on the paper you choose, whole and centred.
quick.note.numbers: Page numbers at the bottom of every page.
quick.note.sign: Opens the file in the editor, ready to fill in and sign.
quick.note.unlock: A copy that opens without a password. You need its password once.
quick.settings.title: Quick tools
quick.settings.menu: Show the quick tools in File Explorer's right-click menu
quick.settings.menuNoteWindows: Right-click PDFs, pictures or Office files. On Windows 11 they are under "Show more options" (or hold Shift while you right-click).
quick.settings.menuNoteMac: In Finder, right-click files and choose Quick Actions (or Services) → أدوات PDF السريعة. You can turn it off in System Settings → Keyboard → Keyboard Shortcuts → Services.
quick.settings.failed: The menu could not be changed. Try again, or restart the app.
quick.lockedNote: Some files are protected. Type their password to go on with them.
quick.problem.split: The parts cannot be read. Write them like 1-3, 4-9, 10-.
quick.settings.ring: Show the ring when I drag files with Ctrl or Shift held (Option or Command on a Mac)
quick.settings.ringNote: Start dragging files while holding Ctrl or Shift (Option or Command on a Mac): a ring of tools opens at the pointer. Let the files go on a tool and it runs straight away, beside the files; or let them go in the middle and then click a tool. Or select files and press Ctrl+Alt+Z (Command+Option+Z on a Mac). Pressing Ctrl or Shift alone does nothing.
quick.settings.background: Keep the quick tools ready (start ZOOD PDF when I sign in, without a window)
quick.settings.backgroundNote: The ring works while the app is running. With this on, it starts when you sign in and waits in the tray (menu bar on a Mac); closing the editor keeps it there.
tabs.label: Open documents
tabs.open: Open another PDF in a new tab
tabs.full: Twelve documents are open: close one to open another.
tabs.copied: The pages were copied to the end of that document. Save it there to keep them.
tabs.copyFailed: The pages could not be copied to that document.
tabs.dropHint: Drop on a tab to copy the pages there, or on + for a new document
tour.title: Welcome tour
tour.welcome.title: Welcome to ZOOD PDF
tour.welcome.body: Read, edit and sign PDFs, Arabic first. No account, and your files stay on this device unless you choose a cloud or AI action.
tour.welcome.p1: Drop a PDF on the window, or choose File → Open.
tour.welcome.p2: On a computer, double-click a PDF to open it here.
tour.tools.title: Every tool is in the side panel
tour.tools.body: The button at the top corner shows or hides the tools: edit text, annotate, sign, organize pages, convert, protect, OCR and more.
tour.tools.p1: Choose a tool; its options open in the same panel.
tour.tools.p2: Nothing changes the original until you save.
tour.tabs.title: Several PDFs, one window
tour.tabs.body: Each PDF you open gets its own tab above the page. Switch with a click, or Ctrl+Tab.
tour.tabs.p1: In Organize pages, drag pages onto another tab to copy them into that file.
tour.tabs.p2: Drag them onto + to make a new PDF from them.
tour.ai.title: Ask the document, or hear it
tour.ai.body: The AI tool chats about the open PDF: summarize it, ask questions, translate. Its own model runs on this device; nothing is sent unless you pick an online provider.
tour.ai.p1: The speaker button reads the page aloud.
tour.ai.p2: A scanned page is read after its text is recognized (OCR).
tour.quick.title: Quick tools, without opening the app
tour.quick.body: Compress, convert to Word or pictures, combine, rotate, extract pages, protect, or make a PDF from pictures and Office files, straight from your files.
tour.quick.p1Windows: Right-click files in File Explorer → PDF Editor: quick tools. On Windows 11 it is under "Show more options".
tour.quick.p1Mac: Right-click files in Finder → Quick Actions (or Services) → أدوات PDF السريعة.
tour.quick.p2: Or hold Ctrl or Shift (Option or Command on a Mac) while dragging files: a ring of tools opens at the pointer. Let go on a tool and it runs at once. Ctrl+Alt+Z opens the ring on the selected files too.
tour.quick.p3: The result is saved beside the original, which stays as it was.
readAloud.ocrFailed: The text could not be recognized. Try Scan & OCR from the tools.
readAloud.ocrNone: No words were found on the page.
look.concept.note: Frosted glass over a soft, colourful background, with large rounded cards.
look.glass.note: Apple's Liquid Glass: light, clear surfaces that let the background through.
look.zood.note: ZOOD's own colours: navy, paper beige and bronze, with the brand pattern.
look.workbench.note: A flat, focused workspace: documents as tabs at the top, all tools down the side, a slim panel rail.
look.mono.note: Greys only and plain line icons, for a calm, distraction-free screen.

prefs.tourHint: A short walk through the app's main features.

prefs.resetAllConfirm: Reset every setting to how it came?
prefs.colorIconsHint: Off draws every icon as a plain line in the text colour, in any look.
prefs.accentHint: The colour of buttons, selection and links.

prefs.reduceMotionHint: No sliding or zooming animations. On by itself when the system asks for it.
prefs.pageLayoutHint: How pages are laid out when a document opens. Also in the View menu.
prefs.zoom.remember: As last time for that file
prefs.directionHint: Arabic books read right to left: page 1 on the right.
prefs.nightHint: Shows pages light on dark. The file itself does not change.
prefs.pagePanelHint: The strip of pages beside the document, each time one opens.
prefs.toolsPanelHint: The list of tools at the side, each time a document opens.
prefs.greetingHint: "Good morning" and your name at the top of the home screen.
prefs.userNameHint: Used only for the greeting, and kept on this device.
prefs.userNameHintSystem: Leave empty to use {name}, your name on this computer.
prefs.homeSectionsHint: Choose which sections show, and their order.
prefs.clearRecentHint: Empties the list and its pictures. The files themselves are not touched.

tour.looks.title: Make it yours
tour.looks.body: Settings › Appearance has five looks: Concept, Liquid Glass, Zood, Workbench and Monochrome. Each comes in light and dark, or follows the system.
tour.looks.p1Mac: Open Settings from the app menu, or press ⌘,
tour.looks.p1Other: Open Settings from the app menu, or press Ctrl+,
tour.looks.p2: Workbench lays the app out as a focused workspace: tabs at the top, tools down the side.

prefs.menu.menusHint: Each word in the menu bar opens its list of commands.
prefs.menu.allHint: Every command is a button: pick File, Edit, View… to see its commands.
prefs.menu.customHint: The commands you tick are buttons beside the menus; the rest stay in the lists.
